title: 3 Ts Will Dominate the Trump-Xi Summit
gist: Rana Mitter argues the Sept 24, 2026 Trump-Xi summit will again center on the 'three Ts' of trade, technology and Taiwan, as at their May 2026 Beijing meeting, with technology made more urgent by rapid AI developments; a transformative agreement on any issue looks unlikely.

insights.claim: US-China summitry between Trump and Xi is organized around three Ts: trade, technology and Taiwan, both at their May 2026 meeting and the September 2026 summit.
insights.speaker: Rana Mitter
insights.so_what: Useful lens for tracking which sectors move on summit outcomes: tariffs, chips/AI and Taiwan risk.
insights.quote: talk was centered on three Ts: trade, technology and Taiwan
insights.locator: When Presidents Donald Trump and Xi

insights.claim: The technology agenda between the US and China has gained urgency because of a sudden and rapid shift in artificial intelligence developments.
insights.speaker: Rana Mitter
insights.so_what: AI is becoming the central bargaining issue, affecting chip export controls and AI-linked equities.
insights.quote: the technology element has been given added urgency by the sudden and rapid shift in developments in artificial intelligence

insights.claim: It is unclear whether the US and China can reach any transformative agreement on AI or any other issue at the September 2026 summit.
insights.speaker: Rana Mitter
insights.so_what: Expect incrementalism rather than a grand bargain; avoid pricing structural resolution.

insights.claim: Trump and Xi previously met at Zhongnanhai in Beijing in May 2026.
insights.speaker: Rana Mitter
